trace.notes: Normalized URL input as zbMATH resolver id 1942938. Local resolver metadata in outputs/open-problems-0418-all.csv and outputs/shards/open-problems-shard-0.csv recorded the entry under the title text 'Three open problems' and the phrase 'open problems'. Direct CLI fetches of zbmath.org and api.zbmath.org failed because the sandbox could not resolve those hosts.

Exact-work search recovered the primary publisher metadata page for Ron Hirshon, 'Misbehaved direct products,' Expositiones Mathematicae 20(4), 365-375 (2002), DOI 10.1016/S0723-0869(02)80013-5. The ScienceDirect page identifies the article as open archive and says its abstract discusses three open problems on direct products of groups, but browser fetch of the article page returned a 403 fetch error and no readable full-text body was available for extraction.

Bounded recovery searched the exact title, DOI, and PDF variants and inspected candidate pages. Recovered candidates were rejected because they were metadata-only/citation pages, blocked publisher pages, or a different later De Gruyter chapter with the same title rather than the exact 2002 Expositiones Mathematicae article.

Input could not be normalized to a readable PDF or HTML full-text source. Failure mode: blocked_or_challenged plus metadata_only. No extraction was performed because the visible recovered sources did not contain the 2002 article's full problem statements.
Saved exact JSON output to outputs/parse-paper/zbmath-1942938.json and outputs/latest.json.
